text:
Ana T.: Quick proposal — run a short launch play: 12-min live demo + microtest of two FAQ copy sets on the pricing page. aim: validate which phrasing drives more calc starts and demo requests.
Markus H.: sounds good. conversion goal for demos?
Ana T.: target 6-8% demo conversion from attendees, secondary lift = +10% calc starts on page vs baseline.
Lina W.: A/B idea: Variant A = conversational FAQ (questions + one-sentence answers), Variant B = technical FAQ (SLA/latency numbers and examples). split traffic 50/50.
Markus H.: gating experiment: Advanced Estimator behind email + company size vs fully inline. gate vs no-gate is a separate binary test.
Jules K.: SDR routing request: if domain in target_account_list OR company_size>1000 => tag:priority_sdr. ops-bot: suggested rule "priority_sdr_if_domain_or_size"
ops-bot: created rule "priority_sdr_if_domain_or_size" (domain_match OR company_size_gt_1000) => tag:priority_sdr
Ana T.: landing headline draft: "Estimate your inference cost in a minute" subhead: "Compare metered vs committed and see a recommended plan."
Lina W.: FAQ microcopy drafts: Conversational A: "How much will this cost me?" -> "Enter usage and we show estimates for both plans." Technical B: "Committed SLA" -> "99.9% uptime, dedicated GPUs, contact sales for custom SLAs." keep bullets to 2 lines max.
Markus H.: webinar outline: 2m why pricing matters, 6m live calc with 3 real-world scenarios, 2m benchmarking slide, 2m CTA + Qs.
Jules K.: benchmarking slide needs a one-liner narrative. Lina, can you draft a 1-paragraph blurb?
Lina W.: draft: "Across representative workloads, choosing the right capacity profile and enabling batching lowered per-token cost by ~28% while keeping median 95th-percentile latency within our SLOs. Use the calculator to model tradeoffs for your workload mix."
Ana T.: good start, will add exact numbers before slide deck freeze.
Markus H.: tracking: UTM = pricing-microtest-2945678901, add ?variant=A|B and &gate=on|off. capture utm in embed.
Jules K.: dev snippet for embed (iframe):
```
<iframe src=\"https://embed.redwood.ai/pricing-calc?utm=pricing-microtest-2945678901&variant=A&gate=off\" width=\"100%\" height=\"560\"></iframe>
```
Ana T.: registration asks: work email, company size bucket, primary use-case (short). keep form < 60s.
ops-bot: event created "pricing-microtest-2945678901" and tag rule "tag:webinar_inbound" applied to registrants
Markus H.: SDR handoff CSV fields: email, company, company_size_bucket, token_estimate, utm_variant, lead_tags. include free-text use-case.
Lina W.: timeline: promo email Mon, social push Tue, reminder day-before, live Wed. QA copy Mon AM in #marketing-summaries. who can help?
Ana T.: I'll pair with Lina for copy QA Mon. Markus will confirm SDR routing + CSV columns by EOD today.
Jules K.: success metrics recap: demo conversion >=6%, calc starts +10% vs baseline, gated flow lead quality +20% (win-rate proxy).
Ana T.: great — I'll assemble playbook and publish in #marketing-summaries by Monday AM. thanks team :sparkles:
